QUOTE: "**Compile time (no runtime cost):** MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO = my_calloc / MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO = my_free" and "**Runtime:** define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call early... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free);`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. Its table says the runtime path applies with "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` only", which only implies exclusivity.
